decision.evidence: Only 10 of 395 retained guards are subsumed within their origin, with five complementary pairs among inclusion-minimal guards. Full template banks and failed measurements remain preserved.
decision.limitation: Assignment mass is not an acquisition-cost model. The new route has mixed costs and the ordinary solver remains faster on both diagnostic edits.
decision.next_target: Use checked conditional exclusions at ordinary search contexts, without imposing a separate tree. First audit the existing trace-learning and support-checking code; its binary implications do not already justify arbitrary multi-assumption clauses.
decision.result: Shared-prefix allocation covers more assignment mass within 129 nodes on all eight saved banks. Whole-input coverage remains unchanged on both cold targets.
decision.scope: The target pairs are provisioned and exposed. Fresh unlabelled evaluation and automatic origin recognition remain open; no unrestricted-SAT complexity claim.
decision.second_target: Share repeated source restriction and unit-extraction work while preserving causal source maps and clause-deletion invalidation.

limitations: Incremental history audit: old six-table payloads remain byte-identical; every new node and its dependency closure is replayed by both readers. Earlier full-history and partition audits remain hash-bound, not rerun.
Both readers fully check every distinct trial archive. Four repetitions per arm retain identical authority digests; raw archives preserve alternative valid proofs.
All source captures and original templates remain in the verified parent. New selection filters support against the current target without discarding old alternatives.
Greater closed assignment mass is not broader SAT-instance coverage, an optimal search order or a uniformly polynomial algorithm.
Exposed guards and targets from the preceding census. Both target choices and all eight origins are retained, without filtering on new outcomes. No fresh or population claim.
Native and old reuse routes are controls; open and frontier share the new tree, composer, native budget and finish-on-stop policy. Open erases conditional certificates after the same construction.
Every worker starts cold from the exact preceding causal origin archive. No later repeat, cumulative union or separate conditional bank is seeded.

New plan loading, source containment, certificate checks, construction and erasure are inside solve timing. The source capture and extraction costs were already measured in the parent and remain additional.
Native solve has different session handoff and stop-tail publication from all composer arms. Native comparisons are route diagnostics, not an isolated guard-selection effect.
Uniform assignment mass per split is a heuristic. It need not correlate with search cost, native coverage or a minimum-cost tree. All uncovered regions remain open.
All raw templates are retained. Dominance is measured, not used to discard alternative supports that may survive different deletions.
Pending frontier state and copied contexts/certificates are not covered by the 129 output-node bound. The census separately measures retained plan size; process peak memory is not measured.
